verdict.rationale: HumanLayer documents no capability that detects failed CI workflows, diagnoses them, and proposes a fixing pull request. `humanlayer automation run` can launch a coding session from a CI job, but that is a developer building block a user would have to wire up. Draft PR creation is a separate, manually requested action from the GitHub tab or diff view, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can have failed CI workflows automatically diagnosed and fixed with a proposed pull request

citations.quote: Use `humanlayer automation run` to run one Cloud-visible coding session from any automation environment — a CI job, a cron machine, or a script on a server.
Draft PR creation — Ask the session agent to open a draft pull request from the GitHub tab or diff view.
